test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Beaches are Sands.

Some Sands are Deserts.

All Beaches are Oceans.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Deserts are Beaches.

(II) Some Sands are Oceans.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follow:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/556926c6e1094a7b29e9b4823bb6274e9eea160ca72985a77610e449d62f03d6.png] 

Conclusions: 

I. Some Deserts are Beaches. → False (As there is no direct relation given between Desert and Beaches,so it can be possible only).

II. Some Sands are Oceans →** True** (Those part of Sand that is Beaches is also Ocean).

Henc**e, ****Only conclusion (II) follows.**
